verdict.rationale: Bugbot lets teams write project-specific review guidelines in `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files, and team admins can create organization-wide rules in Bugbot Automations. A verbose mode lists which rules were loaded into a review, and an optional 'Automatically Learn Rules' setting is documented. Missing for 10: any evidence of AST/structural pattern rules, linking external style guides, depth on rule syntax and how strictly rules are enforced, and independent or hands-on confirmation that custom rules are applied.
